lastCompletedStory.title: Scope the derivation excuse per clause instead of per whole command

nextStoryContext: hasFrozenIntegerComparand (src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts) now strips quoted spans once (stripQuotedSpans, unchanged), then splits the STRIPPED text on /&&|\|\||;|\n/ (CLAUSE_SPLIT_RE, new const placed after stripQuotedSpans) and requires INTEGER_COMPARAND_RE + !LIVE_DERIVATION_RE to both hold within the SAME clause before flagging -- a derivation token in one clause no longer excuses a frozen literal in a different clause. LIVE_DERIVATION_RE itself is still byte-unchanged and at the same line (171) as main; all new code was added strictly below it so the grep -n-diff byte-unchanged oracle keeps passing (see patterns.md for the line-count-delta gotcha). One pre-existing passing test ('does not flag when git diff main accompanies an integer', originally using a `;`-joined two-clause command) was rewritten to a single-clause form because its old shape was structurally the exact anti-pattern this story closes; the old multi-clause command now lives in a NEW test asserting it correctly flags. Two mixed-clause tests were added to each of the flagged-forms and passing-cases describe blocks per the story's AC4. RULES still has exactly 4 named rules; module purity (2 imports, no fs/Bun.spawn/etc, unchanged export surface) preserved.
